title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A bar on the part that takes the time
summary: The progress bar covered the first scan only, and the first scan is not the long part: up to two and a half minutes passed with nothing on screen.

highlights.title: The loop is visible, and can be stopped
highlights.description: One round costs about twenty seconds on a six thousand file project and Apply all chains up to eight. The loop has its own bar now, and stops between two rounds, which is the only place where stopping is safe.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Remove Everything Unused shows a bar for its loop, saying which round it is on, and can be cancelled between rounds.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Moving the loop into a callback turned one `return` into a silent no operation. It is a flag now, which does not depend on where it is written.
Twenty seconds a round is the cost of rescanning, and rescanning is not optional: a removal can orphan something anywhere in the project.
